title: Air Force flies Benowitz to Archuleta Mesa with props staged
place_text: Archuleta Mesa, Jicarilla Apache reservation, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Paul was very excited when he told him that the Air Force had taken him in a helicopter from Kirtland,

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells about Paul Benowitz, a man in New Mexico in the early 1980s who became convinced aliens were active nearby. Bishop says, drawing on men named Rick Doty and Bill Moore, that the Air Force flew Benowitz by helicopter from Kirtland, an Air Force base, to Archuleta Mesa on the Jicarilla Apache reservation, where props had been set out for him to see, and that Paul was thrilled about it. If true, it would mean the military deliberately fed him a false story.
